description: Villa Gecko Dorado is part of an 18th. C. Heritage Portuguese house. Set in a serene yet vibrant tropical flowering garden, the villa with it's own private entrance is a chic and unique living space. It's lavish interiors are themed around an eclectic mix of modernity with a combination of strong artistic influences. The living room opens out to a private pool where one can lounge or relax on sit-outs while taking in the sights and sounds of the garden surrounded by the swaying coconut palms. The space The elegant Villa Gecko Dorado offers with its cosy living space adorned with carefully curated art pieces, a colonial style bedroom, spacious attached bathroom and equipped kitchen that insures guests to enjoy there comfort and complete privacy in style. The living room opens out to a private pool. Guest access Gecko Dorado is a full compounded private Villa. Other things to note Gecko Dorado is located 2,5 km from Benaulim beach. Transport can be arranged. Registration details HOTS000886
